autoDeployEnabled.description: Enable LAPS for PreStage-created managed local admin accounts.

autoRotateEnabled.description: Whether passwords auto-rotate on a fixed interval.

autoRotateExpirationTime.description: Seconds between automatic password rotations (rotation interval).

passwordRotationTime.description: Seconds before an admin-viewed password is rotated (rotation-after-viewing interval).

info.description: Tenant-wide LAPS settings (Settings > Computer Management > Security > Password settings for managed local administrator accounts). The endpoint is live on /v2/local-admin-password/settings but is NOT published in Jamf's public pro.json spec — this file is the self-contained schema. Remove this spec + its config.json SpecDef once the path appears in the published JPAPI spec.
info.title: Jamf Pro API - Local Admin Password (LAPS) Settings
